title: Alert quality
history.title: Accepted requests and recorded results
history.help: Read original requests and their exact signed results. Refresh explicitly to reconcile an uncertain request. No write is retried; an expired request without a result remains unconfirmed.
history.truncated: Only the 25 most recent requests are shown. This is not the full history; an uncertain request is looked up by its original key.
history.empty: No matching accepted request was returned. This does not prove a sent request was cancelled or had no effect.
history.unavailable: Authoritative request history is unavailable. No completion, cancellation or empty history is inferred.
history.failed: Request history could not be read or validated. No write was retried and uncertain requests remain held.
history.detailMissing: No exact proposal detail is retained for this result. No baseline, approval or outcome is inferred.
history.incident: Active dependent incident at the baseline
history.iacOwner: IaC ownership established at the baseline
history.serviceOwner: Service ownership verified at the baseline
history.metricsMissing: No detector replay applies to this treatment. Delivery, SLO, response and recovery guards still require independent evidence.
history.guardHelp: Baseline / treatment on the same frozen scenarios. These are detector measurements, not delivered notifications, business savings, live approval or promotion.
history.processHelp: This is the recorded invocation, not a live approval decision. Open its canonical Process journal for current approvals, dispatch, independently verified effects and recovery; this page owns none of those transitions.
history.processMissing: No canonical Process reference was returned. No approval or outcome is inferred.
history.openProcess: Open this Process and its evidence
subtitle: Review alert noise evidence and prepare a bounded proposal without changing managed resources.
scopeHelp: Choose an exact opaque reference returned for your signed-in principal. URL selectors never grant access; emails, URLs and Azure resource paths are not scope inputs.
scopeRequired: Select one authorized scope. A single discovered scope opens automatically; an invalid or ambiguous URL scope never starts an assessment read.
scopeRefreshHelp: Refresh withdraws the selected report while permissions are read again. Switching or refreshing scopes stops local waiting only; a sent request may still finish.
scopeUnauthorized: The URL scope is not in the current authorized list. No assessment has been requested for it. Select an authorized scope instead.
noScopes: No alert-quality scope is configured for this principal. Ask the environment owner to add an exact authorized scope. No assessment read or request has been started.
scopesUnavailable: Authorized scope discovery is unavailable. Existing URL values cannot bypass it; no assessment has been fetched.
scopesFailed: Authorized scopes could not be read or validated. Refresh explicitly or sign in again. No automatic retry or assessment read was started.
signInRequired: Sign in to view authorized Live scopes. Anonymous and Sample modes never discover scopes or submit requests.
assessHelp: Requests a new frozen assessment when the producer is available and enabled, even if the previous report is missing or expired. The server checks admission. This does not test notifications, approve a plan or apply a change.
requestableYes: Requestable; rechecked by the server on submission
requestabilityMissing: Not projected by this older producer
postureBody: Availability and enablement are not approval. Proposals require server-side scope, ownership and evidence checks; execution remains separately governed.
runtimeHold: Requests are unavailable, disabled or explicitly held by the server. Retained reports and plans remain readable; their presence does not enable requests.
liveOnly: This route requires authoritative Live evidence. Sample data cannot start requests.
loadUnavailable: The authoritative alert-quality source is unavailable. No empty or synthetic report has been substituted.
loadFailed: The alert-quality response could not be read or validated. Refresh explicitly; no request is retried automatically.
reason.scope_not_configured: No authorized scope is configured for this principal.
reason.assessment_not_current: The stored assessment is not current. No current measurement is asserted.
reason.assessment_expired: The recorded assessment has expired. It is not current evidence. A new assessment can be requested when the producer is ready.
reason.assessment_pending: An assessment request is pending. No completed assessment or measured zero is implied.
reason.proposal_pending: A proposal request is pending. No plan, approval or execution is implied.
reason.held: The producer reported a hold or limitation. Review the authoritative workflow; no approval or effect is inferred.
reason.evidenceHeld: Required evidence is incomplete. Collect the missing sources before preparing a change.
reason.targetHeld: The target or its enabled state is not established by current evidence.
reason.protectedHeld: Protected traffic or automation depends on this path. Retain delivery; no change is authorized.
reason.incidentHeld: An active dependent incident blocks tuning this detector or route.
reason.ownershipHeld: Service or infrastructure-as-code ownership is not verified. Resolve ownership before proposing a change.
reason.processingHeld: Effective processing-rule semantics, overlap or exact target scope are not safe to change.
reason.dependenciesHeld: The full shared dependency boundary is incomplete or extends outside the authorized scope.
reason.audienceHeld: Audience membership, delivery paths or primary/backup response coverage are not established.
reason.collectionHeld: An independent collection path has not been proven. Suppression cannot proceed.
reason.windowHeld: The finite window is missing or exceeds server-owned policy or authorization bounds.
reason.propagationHeld: The proposed start does not leave the propagation budget required by the server. Do not infer a universal minimum delay.
reason.evaluationHeld: The native rule kind or evaluation semantics are unsupported. Keep the existing detector.
reason.evaluationAxisHeld: Evaluation tuning must change exactly one supported parameter against the server's current baseline.
reason.evaluationEvidenceHeld: Independent detector replay and guard-metric evidence are missing. A quieter detector is not a validated improvement.
reason.evaluationEvidenceMismatch: The detector replay receipt does not match the target revision, proposed values or current validity. The server has held the change.
reason.routingHeld: The source or replacement binding does not match the observed configuration. Review the two existing groups; no new group is created.
reason.deliveryCoverage: Delivery history is incomplete. Missing attempts, deliveries or acknowledgements are not measured zeroes.
reason.historyCoverage: Source alert history is incomplete. The observed episodes cannot establish the full alert volume.
reason.candidateLimit: The bounded candidate limit was reached. Returned findings do not cover every potential candidate.
reason.reasonLimit: The report reached its limit for evidence reasons. The displayed reasons are not a complete list of limitations.
reason.requestExpired: The request expired before completion. No fresh plan or operational effect is implied.
reason.scopeDenied: The current principal is not authorized for this scope. Select a scope from a fresh authorized list.
reason.evidenceMissing: The requested frozen evidence is no longer retained. Request a new assessment instead of reusing the old digest.
reason.syntheticHeld: Synthetic evidence cannot support this Live request. No operational measurement or change has been inferred.
notPublished: No frozen assessment is published in this projection. This is not a measured zero or proof that no alerts exist.
periodMissing: Not recorded for this assessment. Cutoff and validity are not substituted for the measurement window.
periodHelp: Recorded observation window: start included, end excluded. This is separate from evidence validity.
clockNote: Validity labels use this browser's clock for display only. The server revalidates its own clock before admitting any request.
denominators: Counts cover the returned scope, not the rule filter. These are separate denominators, not a funnel. Missing delivery or acknowledgement evidence is never zero; fewer notifications do not prove better detection.
partialCounts: Counts describe only the observed portion. Missing coverage does not prove absence.
findingsHelp: Observed findings stay separate from proposals, approval and provider effects.
filterLimits: Filters narrow returned findings only; report totals and the recorded observation period do not change. Team ownership and audience kinds stay unknown when their source evidence is missing. A service reference is not a team.
requestedPeriodHelp: Choose a source-read interval, then request an assessment. This does not change the current report or guarantee complete historical evidence.
invalidRule: The rule selector is invalid or ambiguous. No wider rule view has been substituted.
noFindings: No findings are returned in this report. This is not a claim that every alert is necessary or that detection is healthy.
noMatchedRule: The selected rule has no finding in this bounded report.
notProtected: Not marked protected; not permission to change
potentialHelp: Potential reach is an estimate, not a count of people who received or read a message.
page: Findings {start}-{end} of {total} in the returned report
noChange: Keeping the existing configuration is a valid outcome. Leaving this report without submitting requests no managed-resource change.
proposalHelp: Choose routing, a finite notification window or one evaluation parameter for a report rule. This creates an inert proposal only. The server rechecks scope, current evidence, ownership and all affected dependencies.
proposalHold: Proposal input needs complete, current, reason-free evidence and a non-protected finding relevant to the selected treatment. Producer readiness does not establish proposal or approval eligibility.
proposalFields: Complete the selected treatment's required inputs. Exact references are not trimmed, rewritten or expanded into provider IDs. The server remains authoritative.
routingFieldsHelp: Name two distinct existing group references. The server must verify the source binding, replacement, shared dependencies and primary/backup coverage. No group is created here.
otherTreatments: One proposal changes one treatment axis. Switching treatment clears the previous inputs; routing, suppression and evaluation fields are never combined.
draftPreviewHelp: This is a preview of your inputs, not observed configuration, approval or a completed dry-run. Only the server can bind the current baseline and admit the exact plan.
baselineHelp: The report does not project the native baseline. Copy every field from the governed configuration for this exact target. These entries only construct the proposed evaluation; they are not sent as baseline evidence. The server builds its own comparison from the pinned current revision and requires independent replay validation.
evaluationInputHelp: Thresholds accept finite decimal or scientific numbers with a dot, without spaces or digit grouping. Window and frequency use whole seconds from 1 to 86400. Only the selected parameter changes; metric, comparison and aggregation stay as entered. Native provider restrictions are checked by the server.
suppressionPrerequisite: An approved, already provisioned processing rule is required for this exact target. Provisioning is a separate governed IaC prerequisite. This form creates no Azure resource, group, receiver or provider ID.
preprovisionedConfirm: I am referencing an approved, pre-provisioned processing rule. This acknowledgement is not change approval; the server must verify the prerequisite.
windowInputHelp: Enter absolute RFC 3339 start and end values with seconds and Z or an explicit numeric offset. The end must follow the start. No local-time conversion, recurring schedule or invented observation period is added; the server checks maximum duration and authorization.
propagationHelp: Azure documents that processing changes can take up to 30 minutes. This is neither a minimum delay nor a guarantee of activation. The server owns propagation, observation and recovery budgets; immediate storm relief is not promised.
validation.reference: Enter the exact existing opaque reference: lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens, starting with a letter. Do not enter provider paths, addresses or spaces.
validation.target: Select a non-protected target from this report for the chosen treatment.
validation.different: Choose a replacement group different from the existing group.
validation.timestamp: Use a real RFC 3339 calendar time with seconds and a known offset, for example the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+00:00. At most six fractional digits are supported.
validation.future: Choose an absolute future start. The server still applies its actual propagation and authorization bounds.
validation.positiveInterval: The absolute end must be later than the start, including their offsets.
validation.preprovisioned: Confirm the approved pre-provisioned rule prerequisite. The acknowledgement cannot authorize provisioning or execution.
validation.number: Enter a finite decimal or scientific number without spaces, hexadecimal notation, digit grouping, overflow or underflow to zero.
validation.seconds: Enter whole seconds from 1 to 86400 without signs, spaces or leading zeroes.
validation.changed: The selected parameter must differ from the entered baseline. All other evaluation fields remain unchanged.
command.pending: Waiting for the request response. No completion or execution is implied.
command.submitted: The request returned. Review the refreshed projection for its result; this is not approval, execution or verified operational success.
command.rejected: The request was not admitted. Refresh evidence before preparing another request.
command.unknown: The request outcome is unknown. It has not been retried. Reconcile the request through the authoritative workflow before resubmitting.
command.blocked: No request was sent. Check scope, runtime, current evidence and input references, then refresh explicitly.
stopHelp: Stops waiting in this browser only. A request already sent may still complete; this is not runtime cancellation.
workspaceHelp: Request fresh evidence or prepare one inert change axis after reviewing the current assessment. Nothing here approves or executes a provider change.
sourceAndAuthorityHelp: Inspect the selected scope, request posture and retained evidence boundary before preparing any request.
noPlans: No plans are returned in this projection. No approval or execution status is inferred.
benefitMissing: No benefit range or measured no-change comparison is projected. Potential reach is not observed savings.
protectedPathsMissing: Rule protection labels are shown in findings. Full preserved-path and automation evidence is not projected; unknown classification remains protected server-side.
outcomeMissing: Delivery effects, guard metrics, restored configuration and post-expiry verification are not projected. Request acceptance and fewer messages do not prove operational success.
removedBinding: Existing group binding named for removal
addedBinding: Existing replacement binding proposed for addition
beforeMissing: The pinned target revision and rollback digest identify the baseline, but its full values are not projected. Only the named treatment fields are shown; no prior evaluation values, measured baseline or reduction is inferred.
quorumHelp: Two distinct authorized humans: service-owner and change-authority lanes. The requester and executor cannot fill either lane. No approval state is included here.
evaluationReceiptHelp: A receipt digest is a reference, not its replay metrics, approval or promotion. Prior evaluation values and measured guard results are not included in this projection.
suppressionHelp: Azure suppression removes all action groups from matched fired alerts, including automated actions. It does not affect Service Health alerts and is not a per-person mute or digest. Suppressed notifications are not resent when the window ends. Independent collection and protected delivery must remain intact; this record does not prove activation or recovery.
evaluationHelp: Valid input syntax does not prove support for a native rule kind or a detection improvement. Recall, missed incidents, latency, observation and promotion evidence are not projected. The server holds unsupported semantics or missing independent detector validation.
approvalsHelp: Read-only navigation from this report. The Approvals workflow owns eligibility and decisions; no custom approval or execution control is provided here.
settings.title: Alert quality settings
settings.help: This scope-wide enabled preference controls new assessment and proposal requests only. A current scoped human Owner must save each revision. Disabling does not cancel accepted work; enabling does not change promotion, approvals, recovery or execution authority.
settings.refreshHelp: Reads this scope's preference and server-reported role once. It never retries a save.
settings.reason.store: The preference store is unavailable. Its current value, revision and recorded time are unknown; no default is substituted.
settings.reason.writer: The proposal writer is not bound. Saving an enabled preference cannot make requests available.
settings.reason.producer: The assessment producer is not ready. A preference or retained report cannot establish producer readiness.
settings.loadUnavailable: The settings projection is not available. No current preference or revision has been inferred.
settings.loadFailed: Settings could not be read or validated. Refresh explicitly after checking your account and scope; no automatic retry was started.
settings.requestHold: New requests stay held while the current enabled preference or prerequisites cannot be confirmed, a preference save is pending, or its result needs reconciliation. Refresh settings, then evidence. Only changing Settings requires Owner; request admission remains independent.
settings.authority.loading: Reading the current role from the Operator API.
settings.authority.owner: The Operator API reports Owner for this principal. The server rechecks the current human, role, scope and revision on every save.
settings.authority.read-only: View only: the server-reported role does not establish Owner for this signed-in principal. Assessment requestability is separate.
settings.authority.unavailable: The current Owner role could not be confirmed. Browser token claims and cached capabilities cannot unlock preference changes.
settings.authority.denied: The server denied access. Preference changes remain locked in this route session even if cached role data reports Owner.
settings.command.pending: Waiting for the preference revision receipt. No saved state or execution is implied.
settings.command.saved: The preference revision was recorded. Refresh evidence to read current request admission. This did not approve a plan, promote a capability or change a managed resource.
settings.command.conflict: The preference revision changed. Nothing was overwritten. Refresh settings, review the current value and choose a new update deliberately; no save is retried automatically.
settings.command.denied: The server denied this operation. Editing stays locked in this route session. Review your account and authorized scope; no automatic retry was started.
settings.command.rejected: The server did not admit this preference update. Refresh settings before preparing another save; no automatic retry was started.
settings.command.blocked: No preference update was sent. Recheck the current account, Owner role, selected scope and revision, then refresh settings explicitly.
settings.command.unknown: The preference save outcome is unknown. A refresh may show the current value but does not confirm this request. Editing stays locked; reconcile the saved revision before reopening this route. No save has been retried.
